name: Vertex AI
desc: Google Cloud's former platform, now Gemini Enterprise
desc_zh: Google Cloud 的企业级 AI 与 Agent 平台，2026 年更名 Gemini Enterprise
solves: Model, hosting and audit trail bought and configured separately, which is what a regulated reviewer asks about. Vertex bundled them; it is now Gemini Enterprise.
solves_zh: 模型、托管和审计记录要分开采购配置，这正是受监管审查会追问的。Vertex 把三者打包，2026 年更名 Gemini Enterprise。
best_for: A regulated team that needed Gemini behind a traceable audit trail rather than a spreadsheet of it.
best_for_zh: 受监管的团队需要在一份可追溯的审计记录下用 Gemini。

revisions.why: 与同类模型平台保持一致
